summary: Lassen County observation cabin, about the 1940s; the register describes a standing ruin with collapsed walls as of May 2025.

facts.design: 8x8 observation-only wood ground cabin with a wood catwalk
facts.status_note: Walls have collapsed; the platform is mostly intact as of May 2025, per the register.

events.note: Register gives 'Circa 1940's', so the year is approximate
As of May 2025 the walls had collapsed, the platform was mostly intact, and most of the roof lay about 50 feet downhill

corrections.why: The register describes a standing ruin with collapsed walls as of May 2025, which fits the ruins status. The FFLA list says gone without a date. For editor review.
The register gives the build date only as circa the 1940s.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The FFLA list says gone; the register's detailed description says standing ruin. The register's description is preferred because it gives the condition in more detail.

notes_for_editor: Only the register entry and the FFLA county list had Lava Peak history. The californialookouts.weebly.com Lava Peak page holds only township data. No staffing or fire history was found, so none is written. The register mentions a trailer residence noted on the Thornton survey; not used. The status correction (gone to ruins) and the built-year precision are for editor review. Low confidence: only the register and one FFA list entry cover this site, so the history is thin.
